Dane Clark appears in 24 recordings across 4 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1945 to 1979. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Dane Clark most often in Crime and Peter Chambers, Lux Radio Theatre, NBC University Theater, and Sears Radio Theater.

Characters credited here include Peter Chambers.
